reviews.title: WiFi does not work with LINUX
reviews.comment: The card is amazing.  However the wifi is a realtek 7927 chipset with ZERO Linux support.  Realtek has not put our a driver to support LINUX  Maybe AMD can put a little pressure on realtek to support Linux.  Everything else on this card is amazing.  Hey AMD I run AMD not INTEL  so keep my support and lets get the wifi working with Linux  Thanks.
reviews.author: Gib
